response.overview: In a breathtaking journey spanning 800 km across the rugged spine of the Pyrenees, elite ultrarunner Fernanda Maciel takes on the legendary GR11 trail—alone. From the Atlantic shores of Hondarribia to the Mediterranean cliffs of Cap de Creus, she runs for twelve days and twelve hours, fully self-supported, carrying everything she needs to survive. This stunning documentary invites you to witness the raw beauty of the land, the resilience of the human spirit, and the quiet power of being truly present.
